acceptance_criteria.description: GitHub Actions validates sources and uploads deterministic JSON/CSV views without committing generated output.
Repository discovery and Issue fields support the ledger while BMP schemas, runner semantics, protocols, and evidence claims stay fixed.

objective: Add the narrow repository discovery, GitHub workflow, CI trigger, and benchmark Issue fields required to publish disposable generated experiment-ledger views without changing BMP semantics or treating artifacts as evidence.
title: Integrate generated ledger with repository and GitHub
